Email template — Purchase Invoice

Configure the email template that will be used when sending purchase invoices to internal recipients such as employees or managers for review and approval.

This template is specifically for internal distribution and differs from templates used for customer-facing documents.

Template Customization

Customize the subject line to clearly identify the purchase invoice and its purpose. Use placeholders to automatically insert relevant information like invoice number, supplier name, or amount.

The message body can include detailed information about the purchase invoice, payment terms, and any special instructions for internal processing.

Available placeholders will dynamically populate with actual data when the email is sent, ensuring each message contains the correct invoice-specific information.

Subject

Default email subject line when emailing purchase invoices.

Message body

Default email body text when emailing purchase invoices. You can include merge fields to personalize the message.
